elsewhere.note: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out…
seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and…
